title: RegionalEffects
description: Simple plugin allowing the player to set potion effects to a specific WorldGuard region.
body:
# RegionalEffects

**Give your WorldGuard regions special powers with custom potion effects!**

Transform your server's protected areas into dynamic zones that enhance gameplay. RegionalEffects seamlessly integrates with WorldGuard to automatically apply potion effects to players when they enter specific regions.

## ✨ Features

- **WorldGuard Integration** - Works directly with your existing WorldGuard regions
- **Automatic Effect Application** - Players receive effects instantly upon entering configured regions
- **Customizable Intensity** - Set effect levels from 1 to whatever suits your gameplay
- **Simple Configuration** - Easy-to-understand YAML setup
- **Performance Optimized** - Lightweight and efficient region monitoring

## 🚀 How It Works

1. Create your regions in WorldGuard as usual
2. Add matching region names to the RegionalEffects config
3. Specify which potion effect and level you want for each region
4. Players automatically receive effects when entering those areas

Perfect for creating speed zones, jump boost areas, strength training grounds, or any other effect-enhanced regions on your server!

## 📋 Requirements

- WorldGuard plugin

## 🔧 Quick Setup

Simply match your WorldGuard region names in the config file and specify the desired potion effects. The plugin handles the rest automatically!
